question_text: In a municipal health center, the ratio of registered nurses to medical technologists is 5:2. If there are 35 registered nurses, how many medical technologists are employed?

hint_ladder.title: Kilalanin ang Ratio
hint_ladder.text: Ratio ng nurses sa medtechs: 5:2. May 35 nurses. Ilang medtechs? Ang ratio ay parang recipe: 5 nurses, 2 medtechs.

hint_ladder.title: Hanapin ang Halaga ng Isang Part
hint_ladder.text: Ang 5 parts = 35 nurses. Divide 35 by 5 = 7. Bawat part ay 7 tao. Ito ang susi.

hint_ladder.title: Gamitin ang Halaga ng Part
hint_ladder.text: Ngayon, 2 parts para sa medtechs. Multiply 2 by 7 = 14. Yan ang dami ng medtechs.

hint_ladder.title: Piliin ang Tamang Sagot
hint_ladder.text: Sa choices, 14 ang correct. Tandaan: unang hakbang, hanapin ang halaga ng isang part.

A.text: You might have chosen 10 because you multiplied the ratio numbers 5 and 2 directly, forgetting to find the unit part.

B.text: Correct. Five parts equal 35, so one part is 7; two parts for medtechs give 14.

C.text: You might have chosen 15 because you subtracted 20 from 35, mistaking the difference for the answer.

D.text: You might have chosen 20 because you used 4 parts (maybe 5-1) instead of the correct 2 parts for medtechs.

next_time_rule: Sa ratio, unang hakbang: i-divide ang known quantity sa kanyang ratio number para makuha ang isang part, saka i-multiply sa kabila.
blueprint_id: Ratio and Proportion — finding unknown quantity in direct proportion
deconstruct_text:
Sa Barangay San Roque Health Center, may 35 nurses. Ang ratio ng nurses sa medical technologists ay 5:2—parang sa isang maliit na team, para sa bawat 5 nurses, may 2 medtechs.

Para malaman ang bilang ng medtechs, unahin ang halaga ng isang 'part'. Kung 5 parts = 35, isang part = 35 ÷ 5 = 7. Tapos, 2 parts para sa medtechs: 2 × 7 = 14. Kaya 14 ang sagot.
